mapping_notes: error_count_before is the printed D9 aggregate errors with no orchestration (Initial column, 133,496); error_count_after is the printed D9 for Year 3 (106,534). Avoided at full scale = 26,962 = printed D10 for Year 3.
adoption_by_year = D10 / 26,962 = 4,149 / 12,005 / 26,962 over 26,962, which reproduces the printed D10 ramp.
We start from printed D9 because the printed D4 and D6 inputs are rounded; recomputing D9 from them lands within 0.1% of the printed values (see recompute.py).
Cost per error $475 is a weighted average of 68% at $18, 27% at $180, 3% at $1,800, 2% at $18,000 (footnote 10), which recomputes to $474.84.
